businesses.business: premium athletic country clubs and fitness centers

offering_description.value: Operates large premium health, fitness and wellness destination centers in North America, selling recurring memberships to individual consumers and families. Centers combine gyms, group classes, pools, spas, cafes, kids programs, pickleball and personal training; it also offers digital fitness and wellness products.

primary_products.value: nutritional supplements; cafe food and beverages; athletic apparel and retail goods; digital fitness app content

primary_services.value: club memberships; personal training; group fitness classes; spa and salon services; kids programs and child care

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual and family members paying monthly dues, in-center spenders on training, spa and kids programs; B2B: corporate wellness partners and employers, medical and wellness partners, media and advertising partners

end_markets.value: health and fitness clubs; wellness and spa; consumer leisure and recreation

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring monthly membership dues for center access and digital app; service fees: personal training, group classes, spa, kids programs, racquet and pickleball play; product sales: cafe food, supplements, apparel and retail items sold in centers; rental or leasing: space leased in centers to third-party operators
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; product sales; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and leases large athletic club facilities and equipment, serves member consumers directly; retailer: sells food, supplements and apparel to members in centers, purchases from suppliers; service provider: provides fitness training, spa and child care services to members

geography_served.value: North America: About 180 centers in the US and Canada, concentrated in metropolitan markets across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: athletic clubs with related spa, kids, cafe, retail, digital and wellness offerings

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned and leased athletic country clubs and centers; online: membership sign-up, digital fitness app and e-commerce; direct sales: membership sales staff and corporate partnership programs

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Normal business rules: health club membership laws, consumer protection, health and safety, child care licensing, food service rules

notes: Center count and minor revenue lines such as space leasing and digital media are approximate.
